answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in voyage and mirror lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the hollow graph. Verification costs 5 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 1897 account sybil into a 1 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
